trigger: The frozen aligned-program model passed utility but collapsed to rank 1.22-1.31. Read-only diagnosis showed a rank-29 decoder, post-private oracle sample rank 12.89-14.34, and a donor-grouped linear probe recovering rank 12.40 from the existing hidden summary.
primary_question: Does assigning the shared head an explicit training-only post-private coefficient target recover a useful, seed-reproducible, non-collapsed representation without per-organ harm?

architecture.shared_path: unchanged 768-dimensional observed-gene mean hidden summary, 64-dimensional nonlinear head, and exact fixed 32-component decoder
architecture.private_path: hard-dispatched K8 residual adapters trained first and then frozen for both decoder conditions
architecture.target: per-draw least-squares projection of the training-only residual after frozen pooled plus private prediction onto the masked rows of the fixed decoder
architecture.target_standardization: per-component mean and standard deviation calculated only from the frozen phase-2 training schedule

training.mask_scope: 30 percent of frozen score genes per fitting draw

evaluation.performance_aggregation: equal organs, equal held-out donors within organ
evaluation.seed_policy: report all three fixed seeds; select none

success_gate.joint_requirement: utility, extended-budget controls, per-organ safety, cross-seed alignment, and all three non-collapse gates must pass

decision_rule.joint_pass: advance once to prospective study-disjoint confirmation
decision_rule.utility_only: stop repairing coefficient identifiability and pivot representation
decision_rule.alignment_only: do not advance a representation that lacks utility or safety
decision_rule.joint_fail: pivot Stage 2 beyond this expression-PCA program representation

claim_boundary: This is a single bounded, diagnosis-driven repair evaluated on donor-disjoint GTEx development data. It cannot establish biological mechanism, independent-study universality, or downstream spaceflight or disease utility.
